description: This file implements the HttpAuthCache class, managing HTTP authentication cache entries, including lookup, addition, removal, and eviction policies, with focus on paths and realm matching within the cache.

classes.name: HttpAuthCache
classes.description: Manages a cache of HTTP authentication entries, supporting lookup, addition, removal, and eviction based on usage and path matching.

classes.name: HttpAuthCache::Entry
classes.description: Represents a single HTTP authentication cache entry, including realm, scheme, credentials, paths, and challenge data.

classes.name: HttpAuthCache::EntryMapKey
classes.description: Key used for indexing cache entries, based on scheme, host, port, target, and network anonymization key.

methods.name: HttpAuthCache::SetKeyServerEntriesByNetworkAnonymizationKey
methods.description: Sets whether server entries are keyed by network anonymization key and removes server entries if the setting changes.

methods.name: HttpAuthCache::Lookup
methods.description: Finds a cache entry matching scheme, realm, target, scheme, and network key.

methods.name: HttpAuthCache::LookupByPath
methods.description: Finds a cache entry matching scheme, realm, target, network key, and path, considering path hierarchy.

methods.name: HttpAuthCache::Add
methods.description: Adds a new cache entry or updates an existing one with provided credentials and path.

methods.name: HttpAuthCache::UpdateStaleChallenge
methods.description: Updates the challenge string of an existing cache entry.

methods.name: HttpAuthCache::Remove
methods.description: Removes a cache entry matching specified parameters if credentials match.

methods.name: HttpAuthCache::ClearEntriesAddedBetween
methods.description: Clears cache entries added within a specified time range.

methods.name: HttpAuthCache::CopyProxyEntriesFrom
methods.description: Copies proxy entries from another cache.

methods.name: HttpAuthCache::EvictLeastRecentlyUsedEntry
methods.description: Removes the least recently used cache entry to prevent cache overflow.
